scope: Corollary 1.2 (Quadratic norm paving in Ocneanu ultrapowers) of the manuscript “Quadratic Strong-Operator Paving over Arbitrary Maximal Abelian Subalgebras” (preprints/Quadratic-Strong-Operator-Paving-over-Arbitrary-Maximal-Abelian-Subalgebras-September-25-2026/Quadratic-Strong-Operator-Paving-over-Arbitrary-Maximal-Abelian-Subalgebras-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 300 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d0cda0544b3c1b1b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A ⊆ M be a masa. Suppose that A is countably decomposable and is the range of a normal conditional expectation from M. Let ω be a free ultrafilter on N, and let Aω ⊆ Mω be the associated inclusion in the Ocneanu von Neumann ultrapower. For every 0 < ε < 1 and every x = x∗ ∈ Mω, there are a partition p1, . . . , prε ∈ Aω and an element a = a∗ ∈ Aω such that ∥a∥ ≤ ∥x∥, rε X i=1 pixpi − a ≤ ε∥x∥. Here rε is the same integer as in Theorem 1.1.
